1.Des:
<text|1. During the event, you can purchase a Snowmelt Bundle to receive an Ice Scroll.
|news_fans_text>

2.Des:
<text|2. During the event, you can use an Ice Scroll to draw a reward. The chance of winning a Treasure Cell in each Layer is the same, and tiles that have turned into Snowflake Cells will not be drawn.
|news_fans_text>

3.Des:
<text|3. After the event ends, any remaining Ice Scrolls will be automatically used to draw rewards at random in the sequence of Cool Layer, Chilly Layer, and Frigid Layer.
|news_fans_text>
